Name: Valley Girls - French Translation
Author: Jybee
Description:
[b]Valley Girls - French Translation[/b]

[b]What is this?[/b]
Full French translation of all dialogues/events from the “Valley Girls” mod. 
[b]Text-only:[/b] no images, portraits or sounds. Works on top of the i18n patch.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[*] SMAPI 4.x
[*] Content Patcher
[*] Valley Girls (original): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38712
[*] Valley Girls - i18n Patch (load before this translation)
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*] Install the original mod and the i18n patch.
[*] Extract this archive into your [i]Mods/[/i]Valley Girl/i18n folder.
[*] Launch the game via SMAPI
[/list]
[b]Scope[/b]
[list]
[*] Dialogue + Events (including MarriageEvents).
[*] Game language check: only applies when your game language is set to [b]French[/b].
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
Text scope only. Compatible with other mods unless they edit exactly the same entries. 
If conflicts occur, let this mod load after the conflicting one or adjust CP conditions (When/After).

[b]Uninstall[/b]
Safe to remove anytime (text only, no save impact).

[b]Credits[/b]
Original mod: [i]TrashRacc1124[/i].  
French translation: [i]Jybee[/i].  

[b]Changelog[/b]
[i]1.0.0[/i] - French release (dialogues + events).
